title: LocalPilot
description: LocalPilot: local Ollama-backed inline completions and agent chat. Same keys and defaults as the VS Code extension's localpilot.* settings. Changing a setting the core reads restarts the LocalPilot core on the Jupyter server.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server, as seen from the Jupyter server. LocalPilot talks to nothing else.

completionModel.title: Completion model
completionModel.description: Small fill-in-the-middle model used for inline completions (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-base is the higher-quality alternative).

chatModel.title: Chat model
chatModel.description: Tool-calling model used for agent chat.

completionDebounceMs.title: Completion debounce (ms)
completionDebounceMs.description: Delay after the last keystroke before a completion is requested.

completionMaxTokens.title: Completion max tokens
completionMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

chatThinking.title: Chat thinking
chatThinking.description: Let the chat model think before answering (slower).

coreBinaryPath.title: Core binary path (unused in JupyterLab)
coreBinaryPath.description: Kept for parity with VS Code; ignored here. The Jupyter server picks the core binary itself: set $LOCALPILOT_CORE_BINARY or c.LocalPilot.core_binary in the server config.

allowedCommandsAlways.title: Always-allowed commands
allowedCommandsAlways.description: Commands approved with "Always"; the agent runs these without asking.

completionContextTokens.title: Completion context tokens
completionContextTokens.description: Total prompt budget for inline completions (prefix + suffix + related snippets).

chatContextTokens.title: Chat context tokens
chatContextTokens.description: Chat history budget before older turns are dropped.

logLevel.title: Core log level (unused in JupyterLab)
logLevel.description: Kept for parity with VS Code; ignored here. The Jupyter server launches the core: set c.LocalPilot.core_log_level in the server config.

adaptiveCompletions.title: Adaptive completions
adaptiveCompletions.description: Learn from what you do with suggestions (accepted, partly taken, typed through, rejected): per language, adapt how long completions are and add a few of your accepted completions as style examples. Outcomes are logged to .localpilot/completions.jsonl in the server root either way.
